A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the '''commander''' of the [[Imperial Listening Post]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]]. The [[Commander/Legends|commander]] was among the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] casualties when the facility was [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Desolator crisis)|raided]] by a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]].
